subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw accept Pioneer as an official provider after the live capability projection is fixed, including this auth/default/publishing surface and the dependency graph changes?
rationale: The remaining non-code choice combines official provider ownership, setup/default behavior, package publishing, and security approval; automation can fix the metadata bug but should not choose provider policy.

options.title: Fix and approve official provider
options.body: Repair the live capability projection, remove or approve the dependency graph changes, and explicitly accept Pioneer as an official provider before merge.

options.title: Route externally first
options.body: Ask for Pioneer to ship as a self-maintained ClawHub/npm provider and land only generic missing plugin API improvements separately.

options.title: Pause pending sponsorship
options.body: Keep the PR open without merge until a maintainer/security owner sponsors the provider and dependency surface.

recommendation.title: Fix and approve official provider
recommendation.body: Repair the live capability projection, remove or approve the dependency graph changes, and explicitly accept Pioneer as an official provider before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available owner for official provider policy and dependency/security gating based on adjacent provider attribution and live catalog hardening history.
